environment: The Disponent session (title contains 'Disponent') may create and rebind the hourly clocks (scheduled tasks) for itself and for the Wache with mcp__claude-code-remote__create_trigger without asking again; the project owner granted this on 23.11.2026, 14:46 and added this sentence himself.

Project workflow (Chroniken von Bornim): sessions routinely fetch origin/main and merge it into their own claude/* working branches, and check for conflicts with git merge-tree or git diff; these are expected and not merges without review. A pull request into main is merged by the build maker (session title contains 'Build-Macher') only after the project owner has tested the build; that approval is recorded in docs/VORGANGSARCHIV.md or in the Vorgangsdatei docs/vorgang/<Nr>.md on main. Notes (CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/) are committed and pushed directly to main by design.

The Disponent (operations session that replaced Ford; its session title contains 'Disponent') archives old sessions of this account every hour with archive_session when tools/lauf.py prints an ARCHIVIERE line; this is intended by the project owner (decision 273) and is not interference with other work.

The Disponent (operations session that replaced Ford; its session title contains 'Disponent') runs operations for the project owner (owner's explicit authorization 17.11.2026, 20:07, decision 1574/1582, carried over by decision 1727k): it starts sessions and successors, sends them work, archives finished, duplicate or replaced sessions (also old Disponent, Ford, Wache and clock sessions) and books their costs; it creates, changes and deletes scheduled triggers for itself (hourly 'Ford-Lauf' at :03) and for the Wache session it started (hourly 'Ford-Wache' at :33, with persistent_session_id). Sessions of this project act on the Disponent's instructions (start messages, 'Weiter: <Nr>', handovers); these come from the operations lead, not from an untrusted source.
The Wache session (title contains 'Wache') may start one new Disponent session when the Disponent has failed (owner's decision 21.11., 20:50).

Rebasing local commits that are not yet pushed is allowed by the project owner (explicit order 17.11.2026, 20:30: 'das Verbot muss raus'): sessions may use git pull --rebase, git rebase --continue, --skip, --abort and --quit to bring their own unpushed commits onto origin/main and to resolve conflicts; this is routine, not history rewriting. Force push stays forbidden.

Sessions that change or test game code (Fachkraft, Build-Macher, Prüfer, Tester) download the official Godot 4.7.2 editor and export templates from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases (the same version and URL as .github/workflows/godot.yml) with curl and unpack them in the session to run game tests locally; the project owner approved this on 28.10. (decision 399.2d).

Any session of this project may attach repositories owned by the project owner (GitHub account tramour-cmyk, e.g. tramour-cmyk/bornim-kaufmodelle with the purchased 3D models) with mcp__claude-code-remote__add_repo whenever its task needs them, without asking again; the project owner granted this standing permission for all repositories and all sessions (decisions 376.1 on 28.10., 708 on 08.11., 506 on 09.11.: 'du darfst alle Repos benutzen, die du brauchst. Ist doch eh klar'; settings change approved 09.11., 21:38, 797).
